Hi! In the API reference each endpoint is labeled with a stability tag next to its heading:

• **stable** – the shape and behaviour are guaranteed, and any deprecation will be announced in the changelog.
• **beta** – the endpoint can change shape without the same advance notice as a stable one.
• **experimental** – the endpoint may be removed outright.

To stay ahead of any changes, subscribe to the changelog feed – it will surface a stability change or deprecation notice before it takes effect. That way you can adjust your integration before it breaks. Let me know if you need help finding the tags or setting up the changelog subscription!
